_comment: Shipping template. `npm run setup` copies this to config.json and edits in place. Secrets never live here — they live in .env.

accounts._comment: One entry per inbox. id must be unique, lowercase, [a-z0-9_-]. Uppercased id is the .env suffix for IMAP/SMTP passwords.
accounts.label: Main

profile._comment: Used to fill reply templates. Leave a field blank and any template referencing it is disabled rather than sending an empty slot.
profile._onboarding_comment: Consent flags for the two onboarding values that live in .env (AIM_DATE_OF_BIRTH, AIM_SSN_LAST4). The values are never stored in this file — config.json is snapshotted into data/backups on change, and identity data should not be copied around. Set ssnLast4Acknowledged via `/ssn confirm` in Telegram or the dashboard toggle so you see the rundown first.

policy._comment: Gates. Auto-send only fires when EVERY applicable gate passes. autoSend.enabled=false ships as the default on purpose.

autoSend._comment: ONBOARDING_INFO is deliberately absent. It can carry date of birth and SSN last four, so it never inherits permission from the category that triggered it — add it here by name only if you want that sent without being asked.

approvals._comment: Anything not auto-sent becomes a Telegram card with Send / Edit / Skip. Cards expire so stale offers cannot be fired days later.

quietHours._comment: Non-urgent pushes are held until the window closes. Interview alerts always break through.

dedupe._comment: Shared across ALL accounts — that is the point. sameClientWindowDays flags a second agency pitching the same end client even when the title differs.

ai._comment: Optional. When enabled, the selected model verifies every new message; rules remain the fallback if the API is unavailable or over budget.

replyTemplates._comment: Optional template body overrides saved by the dashboard. Leave empty to use the concise message-aware defaults.

ammBridge._comment: Optional read-only bridge to automatic-munyun-machine. Reads its applied/saved history as an extra dedupe source. Safe to leave off.
